I must admit, the kingdom's generosity is impressive.
I wonder who I resemble.
ep8.「王子、この子と一緒に、\nこれからも王国を、世界を守っていこう」:
Prince, together with this child,
let's keep protecting the kingdom, the world.

ep8.「王子さまからも、プレゼントがあるんですか！？」: Is there a present from the Prince too!?
ep8.「王子さまが、お茶会を開いてくれる……？」: The Prince is going to host a tea party...?
ep8.「王子のいじわるっ！ そんな王子なんて、えっと……その――」: Prince, you're being a tease! A prince like you, uh… that—
ep8.「王子様と共に、遠い未来まで輝き続けるために」: Together with Your Highness, I'll keep shining far into the future.
ep8.「王子様を癒すことで\n王子様を介して国民のみなさんに癒しが届くはずです！」: Healing you will let that healing reach the people through you!
ep8.「王子様を癒せば、解決です！」: If I heal you, Prince, that'll solve it!
ep8.「理解しました。\nそれが如何なる理由であれ、\n手を差し伸べられた者は、感謝を:
Understood.
No matter the reason, anyone who extends a hand feels gratitude.
ep8.「疲れていたのかしら。よく眠っていたわよ？」: You look exhausted. You were sleeping so soundly, huh?
ep8.「疲れないはずがないものね」: You couldn't possibly not be exhausted.
ep8.「白の帝国と、王国。\nその二国が、末永く共にあることを願っているのだろう」: The White Empire and the Kingdom... they wish those two nations to remain together forever, don't they?

ep8.「私の入賞と、この国、この世界の未来を祝して……」: To toast my win, and the future of this kingdom, this world…

ep8.「私は、亜神としてなすべきことをなすために、\nこの物質界に来ただけだもの」: I came to this realm only to fulfill what a demigod must do.
ep8.「私は日々、王子様と共に輝く二連星であろうと努力しています」: Every day I strive to be a twin star shining alongside Your Highness.

ep8.「美味しそうに焼き菓子を\n頬張る姫さまを見逃してしまいました……」: I missed the chance to see the princess happily devouring those baked treats…
ep8.「良いだろう。遠征続きで、酒宴も縁遠くなっていたところだ」: Fine then. I've been on endless expeditions, haven't had a feast in ages.
ep8.「英雄であることに、負い目を感じることもあるだろう」: Even heroes sometimes feel the weight of their own deeds.
ep8.「詳しい内容はわからないけれど、\nめでたい事があったら、お酒を楽しむってのが決: I don't know the details, but the rule is to celebrate with drinks whenever something joyous happens.

ep8.「警戒心の無さもここまでくると笑えて――」: The lack of caution here is almost laughable—
ep8.「邪魔するわよ、王子！」: I'll get in your way, Prince!
ep8.「震えるほどに光栄だろう？\n私がいいと言うまで帰るのは許さん」:
It must be an honor that makes you tremble, right?
I won't let you leave until I say it's okay.
ep8.「驚くようなことではないと思いませんか？\n喜ばしくはありますが……」: Isn't it something not worth being surprised by? I'm pleased, but…

m110003.そして全階層が出来上がったとき、\n悪霊の迷宮――ではなく悪霊の塔は、\n世界最: When every floor is finished, the Tower of Evil Spirits will become the world's greatest dungeon.

m110003.ダンジョン攻略は冒険の華、\nと冒険者の方々が仰っていたので。\n入口は由緒正し: They say “Dungeon conquering is the flower of adventure,” so we gave the entrance a proper, historic tower design.

m400115.今回の戦いは、一人でも多くの敵を倒す事を目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』なんだ: This fight is a "Grand Annihilation Mission" aimed at defeating as many enemies as possible.

But if it's a battle in the snow mountains, leave it to me.

Let's finish the battle quickly and enjoy the beautiful snow scenery!
Alright, Prince, the “Great Hunt Mission” begins!

m400450.しかし、誤解を解き事態を収拾するためには、\n王子本人による説明が必要不可欠です: Still, the only way to clear up the misunderstanding is for the Prince himself to explain. I suspect it could easily turn into a battle…

m400450.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドを\n入手出来ない点にも気を付けて下さい。: Also, note that defeating enemies won't grant any EXP or gold.
